notificationsDescription: Send a notification when a link reaches a click milestone.
discordDescription: Paste the incoming webhook URL for milestone notifications.
telegramDescription: Enter a bot token and chat ID for milestone notifications.
accessDescription: Control who can create a new account.
adminOnly: Only the configured administrator can open this page.
allowRegistrationsDescription: Existing accounts can still sign in when this is disabled.
accountDescription: Manage your profile and sign-in methods.
profileDescription: Keep your account details up to date.
twoFactorDescription: Add an authenticator app as a second sign-in step.
passwordDescription: Change the password you use to sign in. Your other devices will be signed out.
setupKeyDescription: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter its six-digit code.
recoveryCodesDescription: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once.
passkeysDescription: Use your device biometrics or a security key to sign in.
noPasskeys: No passkeys have been added yet.
passkeysUnavailableDescription: Set PASSKEY_RP_ID on the API and restart it to enable passkeys.
userManagementDescription: Manage access for every account in this workspace.
createUserDescription: Create an account with an initial password.
deleteUserDescription: This permanently deletes {{name}} and their data.
usersDescription: Search, change roles, or suspend access.
advertisingDescription: Show a short AdsTerra interstitial before your selected links redirect.
advertisingUnavailableDescription: Try again to load your advertising configuration.
enableAdvertisingDescription: Visitors see your configured banners before the redirect begins.
automaticRedirectDescription: When the countdown ends, redirect instead of revealing Continue to site.
advertisingNeedsBanner: Add at least one banner before enabling the interstitial.
adsterraDescription: Ready now. Choose a preset and paste your banner code.
adsenseDescription: Google AdSense setup will be available in a future release.
advertisingDelayDescription: Seconds before Continue to site becomes available or the automatic redirect begins. The counter advances only while the page is visible.
adsterraBannersDescription: Each size is configured once and is placed around the redirect page.
adsterraCodeDescription: Paste the invoke.js URL or the complete AdsTerra snippet. We keep only the secure script URL.
